propositions: LLMRunnerError raised on step-budget exhaustion is not caught by the except UnretryableOutputError clause in CompletionAgentStep.run because LLMRunnerError is an ancestor type, not a subclass
Bounded per-criterion recovery mechanism is unreachable when step-budget exhaustion occurs, leaving failure_diagnostic unset
Creating a new typed LLMBudgetExhaustedError(LLMRunnerError) subclass allows interpret_failure to raise a distinct exception type that can be caught without message or diagnostic sniffing

Adding LLMBudgetExhaustedError to the except clause in CompletionAgentStep.run enables budget exhaustion to route to bounded recovery while remaining backward compatible with existing LLMRunnerError handlers
Recovery must preserve the original budget diagnostic on failure_diagnostic so diagnostic counters survive even if recovery itself fails
